scope: Only eight observed seed/setting color-selection findings from the 44-comparison Python review.

confirmed_findings.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((hh (rows g))
         (ww (cols g))
         (bg 8)
         (cells (for*/list ((r (range 0 hh))
                            (c (range 0 ww))
                            #:when (!= (at g r c) bg))
                  (list r c (at g r c))))
         (freq (make-hash))
         (dummy (for ((cell cells))
                  (hash-set! freq
                             (third cell)
                             (+ 1 (hash-ref freq (third cell) 0)))))
         (inner-color
           (let* ((points (map (lambda (cell) (list (first cell) (second cell))) cells))
 (inner? (lambda (cell) (andmap (lambda (d)
   (member (list (+ (first cell) (first d)) (+ (second cell) (second d))) points))
   (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))))
 (inside-count (lambda (color) (count-where (lambda (cell)
   (and (= (third cell) color) (inner? cell))) cells))))
  (car (sort (hash-keys freq) (lambda (a b)
   (if (= (inside-count a) (inside-count b)) (< a b) (< (inside-count a) (inside-count b))))))))
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) bg))
    (for ((r (range 0 hh)))
      (let ((row-cs
              (map second
                   (filter (lambda (cell) (= (first cell) r)) cells))))
        (unless (null? row-cs)
          (let ((left (min-list row-cs))
                (right (max-list row-cs)))
            (when (>= (- left 1) 0)
              (hash-set! result (list r (- left 1)) inner-color))
            (when (< (+ right 1) ww)
              (hash-set! result (list r (+ right 1)) inner-color))))))
    (for ((c (range 0 ww)))
      (let ((col-rs
              (map first
                   (filter (lambda (cell) (= (second cell) c)) cells))))
        (unless (null? col-rs)
          (let ((top (min-list col-rs))
                (bot (max-list col-rs)))
            (when (>= (- top 1) 0)
              (hash-set! result (list (- top 1) c) inner-color))
            (when (< (+ bot 1) hh)
              (hash-set! result (list (+ bot 1) c) inner-color))))))
    (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) bg)))))
